response.justification: Bogdan has ~19 years of broad full-stack, embedded, and mobile engineering experience, satisfying the baseline tenure requirement, but the resume shows no evidence of Director-level strategic leadership, cloud platform strategy, or advising external strategic customers/partners on AI adoption. His AI exposure is limited to a recent (since April 2025) contribution to MCP code generators and agentic tooling, far short of the 'recognized AI expertise with demonstrated AI products/platforms' the role expects. He remains a Staff/Senior IC generalist rather than a principal-level AI strategist.
strengths: Long, diverse engineering career (~19 years) across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Demonstrated ability to work across many languages/stacks and adapt quickly to new tools
Some recent hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic frameworks)
concerns: No demonstrated Director/Principal-level strategic leadership or cross-org influence
Minimal, recent-only AI/ML depth — no track record of building or shipping AI products/platforms
No evidence of cloud strategy work or advising strategic external customers/partners

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI strategy/leadership track record
Career level mismatch (Senior/Staff IC vs Director-level Principal)
